mapper.select: SELECT t.travel_id AS travelId, t.user_id AS userId, t.account_id AS accountId, t.title, t.travel_begin_date AS travelBeginDate, t.travel_end_date AS travelEndDate, t.destination, t.is_generated AS isGenerated, t.travel_img AS travelImg, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt, IFNULL(COUNT(m.user_id), 0) AS memberCount FROM travel_log t LEFT JOIN account_member m ON t.travel_id = m.travel_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.travel_id ORDER BY t.travel_begin_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_log ( user_id, account_id, title, travel_begin_date, travel_end_date, destination, is_generated, travel_img, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{title}, #{travelBeginDate}, #{travelEndDate}, #{destination}, #{isGenerated}, #{travelImg}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account ga WHERE ga.user_id = #{userId} AND ga.account_type = 'group' AND ga.is_deleted = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM travel_log tl WHERE tl.account_id = ga.account_id ) ) AS exists_flag
